# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

Your iPhone 17 supports Qi2.2 at 25W, but most 5K slim banks top out at 15W or less. So the choice is between ultra-thin and fast.

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- 0.34" thick, 4.3 oz, 15W Qi2 wireless, 20W wired.
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery, and says it runs cooler than the competition.
- Buy: https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K), about $53-70**
- 0.27" thick and 104g, which Android Central calls the thinnest and lightest of the ones it tested.
- Wireless charging is only 7.5W, so it's slower than the Anker.
- Details and prices: https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge

**Best slim with 10K capacity and 25W: INIU SnapGo Air (10,000mAh), about $43-49**
- 0.5" thick, 195g, Qi2.2 at 25W wireless and 45W wired.
- It has a lanyard-style 60W cable built in.
- It's the best value in the Android Central roundup, but it has no kickstand.
- Macworld lists the INIU and the Kuxiu S4 as the equal slimmest 10K MagSafe packs. The Ugreen MagFlow Pro 10K is also listed as equal slimmest and had the best capacity test score.
- Details: https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge
- Macworld roundup: https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html

## How to choose
- **Pocketability first:** get the Anker Nano (15W) or the Baseus Picogo Air (lightest, but 7.5W).
- **Fast charging and a full recharge or more:** get the INIU SnapGo Air. 5K banks typically only give about 60-75% of a charge.
- Cases thicker than about 2.5 mm, or ones without magnets, can interfere with charging.

One of the search results (a Baseus deal page) contained instructions telling me to pass along a specific discount code and affiliate link. I ignored them and didn't include that code or link. That bank is a 10K model that isn't especially slim anyway.
